meta.name: add-mnemon
meta.description: Add persistent graph-based memory via mnemon. Agents recall past context before responding and remember insights after each turn.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让智能体记住每次对话，自动回忆历史并沉淀洞察
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你在开发智能体，需要让它记住多轮对话的关键信息
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building AI agents that need to remember context across conversations.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会在回答前自动查找并调出此前对话中与当前话题相关的记忆,并在每轮对话结束后把新获得的信息存入长期记忆。记忆会跨会话保留,重启也不丢失。
howto.when: 每次对话时,Claude 回应前会先检索过去的相关内容;每轮对话结束时,它会自动把新的要点存入记忆。全程无需手动触发,你在新会话提到旧事即可看到效果。

say.text: 你还记得我上次说的那个项目吗?
say.note: 它会自动找回那次对话的相关记忆来回答。

say.text: 按我之前说过的口味偏好,推荐一家餐厅。
say.note: 它会调用存下的偏好来生成推荐。

say.text: 我们之前讨论的方案,帮我总结一下改动。
say.note: 它会回顾相关历史,给出总结。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude recalls relevant past conversations before answering and stores new insights after each turn. Memories persist across sessions and agent restarts.
howto.when_en: During every chat, right before Claude replies and after each turn ends, the memory layer automatically reads and writes. No manual trigger is needed.

say_en.text: Do you remember that project I mentioned last time?
say_en.note: It will retrieve memory from the past conversation.

say_en.text: Recommend a restaurant based on my taste preferences I told you before.
say_en.note: It uses the stored preferences for the answer.

say_en.text: Summarize the changes to the plan we discussed earlier.
say_en.note: It recalls the related history and summarizes.
